lm.intervention_contract: Direct snapshot conditions retain identical incoming warm KV and clocks. memory_read_off_all reencodes prefix with all Bio reads disabled; remote_history_reencoded replaces only tokens older than the baseline multi-layer receptive bound and reencodes KV plus Bio state. Whole-path conditions may change KV. Suffix writes remain enabled.
lm.aggregation: Token-weighted NLL; window means and first-answer measurements are reported separately.
lm.note: Bio has no token KV; its reference window only defines a matched intervention span. Paired windows, not independent training seeds. Direct clear costs retain Bio information already encoded in warm KV. Total read-off also removes static Bio contributions; reencoded-history cost targets remote input dependence.
